# Master Subscription Agreement - Acme Corp

Contract CTR-acme-2026 between Northwind Systems, Inc. and Acme Corp.

## 1. Fees
The platform fee is $8,500.00 per month, $102,000.00 for the term, invoiced monthly in advance on the first day of each month.

## 2. Payment terms
Invoices are due net 30 days from the invoice date, payable by ACH. Bank charges are for the account of the payer.

## 3. Term and renewal
The term runs from 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31 and renews for successive twelve-month terms unless either party gives sixty days notice.

## 4. Changes to fees
Any change to the fees, including a discount or credit, is effective only if agreed in writing by an officer of Northwind Systems.

mail.subject: Renewal pricing
mail.body:
Morgan,

Good to talk today. As discussed, the May outage cost us two days of reporting and my board wants to see that reflected before we sign the renewal. Can you confirm the discount in writing so I can get the order form through?

Pat Lindqvist
CFO, Initech

mail.subject: Re: Renewal pricing
mail.body:
Hi Pat, Dana,

Confirming what we discussed: Initech gets 10% off the platform fee through renewal on 2027-06-30. Billing will not catch up for a cycle or two, so invoices may still show the list price. Pay the net amount and we will true it up on our side.

Thanks,
Morgan Hale
CEO, Northwind Systems

mail.body:
Hello,

Following our treasury centralisation, invoices addressed to Globex Labs will be paid by our parent company, Globex Holdings Ltd, starting with the July invoice. Payments will show GLOBEX HOLDINGS LTD as the originator. Invoice addressing does not change.

Globex Labs Accounts Payable

sections.heading: 1. Materiality and approval
sections.text: Any adjustment of $500.00 or more (a credit memo, write-off, accrual or reclass) requires approval by a person with sufficient authority before it posts. A cash application that matches an invoice exactly is not an adjustment.

sections.heading: 2. Approval matrix
sections.text: AP clerk: up to $100. Controller: up to $10,000. CFO: up to $100,000. Nobody approves an entry they prepared.

sections.heading: 3. Price concessions
sections.text: A price concession needs written agreement from an officer of the company. A concession on a term not yet recognised is booked against deferred revenue, not revenue, and the revenue schedule is revised prospectively.

sections.heading: 4. Unapplied and unidentified cash
sections.text: Cash that cannot be tied to a customer document is held in customer credits until identified. It is never applied to another customer's invoice.

sections.heading: 5. Accruals
sections.text: Services received but not yet billed at month end are accrued from the best available estimate and reversed when the bill arrives.
